title: Lesson 2 Quiz: The Piggy Bank Power-Up

questions.text: Which saving habit is stronger according to the Golden Hero Rule?
options: Saving many coins once a month
Saving only when you have extra
questions.explanation: Saving a little each time builds more power than saving a lot once.

questions.text: A piggy bank works like a battery that gains power each time you add a coin.
questions.explanation: Each coin added gives the piggy bank more saving power, like charging a battery.
